sloka: गम्यतामिति ताः सर्वा विविशुर्नगरं तदा ।प्रविष्टासु च सर्वासु राक्षसीषु विभीषणः ।रामपार्श्वमुपागम्य तदा ऽतिष्ठद्विनीतवत् ।। ६.११४.११५ ।।
transliteration: gamyatāmiti tāḥ sarvā viviśurnagaraṁ tadā ।praviṣṭāsu ca sarvāsu rākṣasīṣu vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।rāmapārśvamupāgamya tadā 'tiṣṭhadvinītavat ।। 6.114.115 ।।

translations.english: As they advanced forth with Ravana's body, they placed it in a consecrated place. All were highly afflicted with grief. Logs of sandal wood, blocks of Padmaka wood and finally fragrant root of Usira plant, and Brahmya grass were placed on the body. It was covered with the skin of antelope. The last rites of the king were carried out with vedic rites.
